description: This file defines the RawIniFile class, which provides methods to parse, access, and manipulate INI file lines. It includes nested class Line to represent individual lines and supports lookups by key, retrieving lines, and converting values to integers.

classes.name: RawIniFile
classes.description: Represents an INI file with methods to access lines by key and retrieve properties.

classes.name: RawIniFile.Line
classes.description: Immutable class representing a single line in an INI file, including tokenization and comment detection.

methods.name: RawIniFile(List<Line> lines)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RawIniFile with a list of Line objects and populates the lookup map.

methods.name: getMandatoryLine(String key)
methods.description: Returns the line associated with the key or throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: getByKey(String key)
methods.description: Retrieves a Line object by key, or null if not found.

methods.name: getLines()
methods.description: Returns the list of all lines.

methods.name: getSimpleIntegerProperty(String key)
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the key, throws if key not found.

methods.name: getSimpleIntegerProperty(String key, int defaultValue)
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the key, or defaultValue if key not found.

methods.name: getValues(String key)
methods.description: Returns a list of string values from the tokens following the key.
